name: data-database-result-field-state-runtime
salesforceExclusionReason: DML result field state is exercised against deterministic local Account records; this fixture makes no hosted Salesforce parity claim.

evidence.notes: Failed insert of an Account missing required Name exposes a populated errors property.
Successful insert exposes the persisted Account Id property.
Failed delete of a record without an Id exposes a populated errors property.
Successful delete exposes the deleted Account Id property.
Failed undelete of an active record exposes a populated errors property.
Successful undelete exposes the restored Account Id property.

source.content: Database.SaveResult badSave = Database.insert(new Account(), false); System.assertEquals(false, badSave.success); System.assert(badSave.errors != null); System.assert(badSave.errors.size() > 0); Account saved = new Account(Name = 'Result Saved'); Database.SaveResult saveResult = Database.insert(saved, false); System.assertEquals(true, saveResult.success); System.assertEquals(saved.Id, saveResult.id); Account removed = new Account(Name = 'Result Removed'); insert removed; Database.DeleteResult badDelete = Database.delete(new Account(Name = 'No Id'), false); System.assertEquals(false, badDelete.success); System.assert(badDelete.errors != null); System.assert(badDelete.errors.size() > 0); Database.DeleteResult deleteResult = Database.delete(removed, false); System.assertEquals(true, deleteResult.success); System.assertEquals(removed.Id, deleteResult.id); Account active = new Account(Name = 'Active Undelete'); insert active; Database.UndeleteResult badUndelete = Database.undelete(active, false); System.assertEquals(false, badUndelete.success); System.assert(badUndelete.errors != null); System.assert(badUndelete.errors.size() > 0); Database.UndeleteResult undeleteResult = Database.undelete(removed, false); System.assertEquals(true, undeleteResult.success); System.assertEquals(removed.Id, undeleteResult.id); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Id = :removed.Id]);
